title: SubstationTelemetryTick
description: Standardized payload emitted by Member 1 to Member 2 on every simulation tick.

timestamp.description: UNIX timestamp of the simulation step.

voltage.description: Phase voltage in Volts (nominal: 230.0V, 0.0V if breaker is OPEN).

frequency.description: System frequency in Hertz (nominal: 50.0Hz, 0.0Hz if breaker is OPEN).

load_mw.description: Current active power drawn in Megawatts (0.0 if breaker is OPEN).

capacity_mw.description: Rated maximum load capacity before triggering an overload condition.

breaker_status.description: Physical switch state ('CLOSED' for power delivery, 'OPEN' for tripped/isolated).

is_overloaded.description: True if load_mw exceeds capacity_mw due to load redistribution.

operator_note.description: Operational log or field note for this substation.
